caption: Learning the task itself. a The models predict the actual NARMA10 target from driving inputs only. The same fixed test excerpt is shown; errors describe its full test split. b Restricting and then expanding the same reservoir circuit's accessible history tests whether older inputs help. Lines show medians over 12 independent runs; shading/bars show 10th–90th percentiles, not confidence intervals. Gray stars are classical quadratic controls (14/90 features), not matched quantum-advantage baselines. c Different earlier inputs followed by an identical continuation can still require different target values (first 32 shared steps shown). After four common inputs the four-input QELM must give the same prediction. Synthetic benchmark, exact-expectation simulation; settings selected on validation only. Reset/replay uses sequential encoding, and longer windows cost more evolution steps.
